quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: yeah, you just tell Emily to refresh and try again. / Taryn Reithofer: Yeah. Okay, cool. I'll uh let her know and close out the ticket. / Kobi Kunasekaran: Okay. Yeah. Yeah, in the ticket maybe like just put a quick summary of like where to go to fix it so that if it does happen for any other related records like we know that's the first thing.

topic: Other objects not checked for layout issue
statement: Kobi judged that the same layout issue is a non-issue for players, operators and partners because users will not create those manually now; referrer is the only record created through the Sign-Up object. This rests on an assumption about client usage.
quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: I guess they wouldn't be creating players manually at this point. They wouldn't be clear creating operators and partners to any related lists at this point. So yeah actually it's it's a non-issue. I think refer is the only one uh where they'll be creating it through the signup object. / Kobi Kunasekaran: So uh we should be okay for now.

topic: BA player related list search/rename
statement: Emily asked whether the player related list on the brand ambassador (user) record page can be searchable and renamed. Taryn told her it cannot: it is on the user object page layout, not a Lightning App Builder page, and the list name is shared with other record types.
quote: Taryn Reithofer: she had asked if the related list was searchable like a searchable table type of list. Um, and I told her it's not because it's in a user object and as we know the user object doesn't have a lot of customization. / Taryn Reithofer: Um, yes. However, it lives elsewhere too that we wouldn't be able to change the name. / Kobi Kunasekaran: Yeah, because I guess it's the same one for all four record types,

topic: Close BA related list ticket
statement: The ticket will be closed. Kobi asked to tie the answer back to the client mockup (the list was added because it was in their mockup) and to say no to renaming. A custom lookup is possible if the client really wants it, but Kobi does not think it is worth the effort.
quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: But I would like tie it back to the initial requirements that it was part of their mockup. So that's why we added it there. So if they don't need it, that's fine. We can remove it. / Taryn Reithofer: I'll close it out. / Kobi Kunasekaran: Yeah. Then just say no. / Kobi Kunasekaran: we can create a another like custom lookup, but I don't think it's worth the effort.

topic: VIP toggle on referrer; same commission
statement: Referrer records need a VIP toggle. Joyce understands the commission rate is the same, so no different payout matrix. A referrer is one record with the toggle and can also refer non-VIP signups.
speakers: Joyce Kiddell; Kobi Kunasekaran; Lina Ceniccola
quote: Joyce Kiddell: Um on the refer side uh we definitely need the uh another toggle just to indicate if that refer is VIP or not and I don't think there's anything else required for it. / Joyce Kiddell: So really it's just like one unique refer and then they can have a toggle that's on off for VIP. / Lina Ceniccola: I would leave it open.

topic: BA players related list deprioritized
statement: The brand ambassador players related list is waiting on Emily to say whether it is needed; search is not possible on that layout. Kobi asks to deprioritize it.
quote: Taryn Reithofer: Waiting on Emity to see if she even cares for this list to be on that record page at all. / Kobi Kunasekaran: cuz they wanted to be able to search but we can't do a search because it's a fancy layout. / Kobi Kunasekaran: So, hopefully you can dep prioritize that.
asr_note: Emity = Emily [ASR]; lines 972-973 ('before launch', 'permissions and access as well') are ambiguous as to which ticket they refer to

topic: Test referrer creation on all paths, notify Emily
statement: Before telling Emily the issue is closed, Taryn will confirm the referrer page matches the latest requirements, create a referrer through every path to check for validation rules or required-field errors, and then let Emily know.
quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: ...confirm that this one has it matches up with latest in terms of the requirements and expectation for what should be on the referral page and then try creating a refer through all of the paths to confirm that it works so she doesn't come back and tell us that there's an error. / Taryn Reithofer: ...I will I will triple check all other locations make sure they're all working the same....
